passage:
Look at the ship. 
Trish and Josh jump on the ship deck. 
Trish has a net to get fish.
Josh has a bag to get shells.

Trish jumps off the ship with the net. 
She swims to get fish. 
Josh jumps off the ship with his bag. 
He swims to get shells.

Trish and Josh get back on the ship. 
“Look at the fish in my net,” said Trish. 
“Look at the shells in my bag,” said Josh.
 We had fun on the ship.
